addon.name: Arctic Zephyr Stremio
addon.provider-name: shiggsy365 (based on Arctic: Zephyr - Reloaded by jurialmunkey, beatmasterRS)

extension.news: v1.1.1 - Kodi Stremio Bridge logo on the startup screen, icon and fanart; "Stremio" in place of "Reloaded" beside the skin name. v1.1.0 - Info page rebuilt around Stremio Bridge: Play, Available streams, Mark watched, Watchlist, Trailer, Find similar, Cast, and a season and episode browser for shows, seasons and episodes; Watched banners; a search page with an on-screen keyboard, live results, suggestions and recent searches (search icon by the clock, or Right on the last menu item); a full-screen TV guide; one clearlogo setting for the whole skin; no header over catalogs; no "New" markers. v1.0.2 - Embeds Stremio Bridge show browsing in the info page with season chips and episode thumbnails. v1.0.1 - Runs Stremio Bridge's setup wizard on first start; Setup wizard in the ... menu; fixed the ... submenu. v1.0.0 - Forked from Arctic: Zephyr - Reloaded 3.0.3 (beatmasterRS, upstream commit 27b7bd7) and renamed. Removed the CJK font set (Inter CJK, 54 MB) to keep the skin small. No TMDb Helper or Embuary. Ready-made Home, Movies and TV Shows menus and hubs; Kodi's info page with Browse show, Mark watched, Watchlist and streaming-service buttons; actors open Stremio Bridge's person search; Stremio Bridge's context menu; a ... settings menu.
extension.summary: Arctic: Zephyr - Reloaded, made for Stremio Bridge.
extension.description: A fork of Arctic: Zephyr - Reloaded by beatmasterRS, itself based on Arctic: Zephyr by jurialmunkey, made to work with Stremio Bridge and Dispatcharr Bridge. Clean, minimal and light, with the layout of Reloaded. Licensed under CC BY-NC-SA 3.0, like the original.
